name: Saint Bella Inc.
summary: Saint Bella Inc., founded in 2017 and based in Hangzhou, offers postpartum care and recovery services, with operations extending to Hong Kong, Singapore, China and the Cayman Islands. Postpartum brands are Saint Bella, Bella Isla and Baby Bella, home care comes under PrimeCare for Family, and it also sells GuangHeTang functional foods for women and S-bra lingerie.
